description: NZ Tunnel Centrelines (Topo 1:500k) (Deprecated) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Topographic Office. An underground passage Data Dictionary for tunnelcl: topo. linz. govt. nz/data-dictionary/tdd-class-tunnelcl. html Note: LINZ Topo500 data is not current. Please use Topo50 layers for up to date data. Topo500 map data will remain on LDS for historic purposes but will not be updated. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Topographic Office. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2025-11-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
